name: Há Fado no Mercado com Sandra Cristina
description: Há Fado no Mercado brings Portuguese music to the restaurants of Bolhão. This performance features fadista Sandra Cristina.
longDescription:
Há Fado no Mercado is an initiative that brings Portuguese music to the restaurants located within Mercado do Bolhão. The performance on this date features the fadista Sandra Cristina.

The program for the evening includes a performance at 20:00 at Nelson dos Leitões - Original da Bairrada, followed by another at 21:00 at Culto ao Bacalhau. The event is free to attend.

It takes place on November 4, 2026, starting at 20:00 at Mercado do Bolhão, located at R. Formosa, 322.
